create_time.description: The point in time the resource was created.

description.description: The description is a longer text chosen by the user to provide more context for the resource.

displayName.description: The display name is a short name chosen by the user to identify the resource.

id.description: A auto generated unique id which identifies the resource.

labels.description: Labels are a set of key-value pairs assigned to resources.

maxMessageSizeKiB.description: The maximum size of a message in kibibytes (1 KiB = 1024 bytes).

maxMessagesPerHour.description: The maximum number of messages per hour.

state.description: The current state of the resource.

uri.description: The URI for reaching the resource.
